scenarios.name: Firebending 2 adds two red mana when Fire Lord Azula attacks
scenarios.ruling: Firebending 2 is "Whenever this creature attacks, add {R}{R}". With no lands on the battlefield the only mana available is the firebending mana, so a {R} instant can still be cast during combat and one red mana is left over.

scenarios.name: Firebending mana is lost once you leave combat
scenarios.ruling: The mana lasts until end of combat and no longer: it survives the steps of the combat phase, but by the postcombat main phase the pool is empty again.

scenarios.name: A spell cast while Fire Lord Azula is attacking is copied
scenarios.ruling: Fire Lord Azula is still an attacking creature until it is removed from combat as the end of combat step ends, so a Lightning Bolt cast during combat is copied; the copy keeps the original's target and resolves first, so the opponent takes 3 twice on top of Azula's 4 combat damage.
